response.sql: WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS units FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, units, 1.0 * units / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_units), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(p.units) AS combined_units, AVG(p.share) AS average_share, AVG(p.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM product_shares AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.share > o.average_share

assumptions.assumption: Nonmissing quantities contain valid whole numbers. Products with no nonmissing quantity have no calculable share and are excluded from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: Count a product whose quantities are all missing as having zero units, so it receives a zero share and counts toward the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)), 0) AS units FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, units, 1.0 * units / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_units), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(p.units) AS combined_units, AVG(p.share) AS average_share, AVG(p.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM product_shares AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.share > o.average_share
